extension.description: Pilot your Striart multi-agent Git orchestrator from VS Code: agents, conflicts, merges and agent requests.
capabilities.virtual: Striart needs a local folder: it launches the striart command in your repository.
capabilities.untrusted: In an untrusted workspace Striart stays inactive: starting it would load the repository configuration, which is code. Grant trust to enable it.
views.container.title: Striart
views.agents.name: Agents
views.agents.title: Striart agents
welcome.untrusted:
Striart is inactive because this workspace is not trusted. Connecting would run `striart`, which loads the repository configuration (code).
[Manage Workspace Trust](command:workbench.trust.manage)
welcome.notInitialized:
This folder is not a Striart repository.
Run `striart init` in a terminal; the view connects by itself as soon as `.striart` appears.
welcome.binaryMissing:
The `striart` command could not be started.
Install Striart, or set the path in your **user** settings (it is never read from the workspace).
[Open settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22striart.binaryPath%22%5D)
[Show output](command:striart.showOutput)
welcome.blocked:
Striart refused the connection (for example because VS Code runs inside an agent session, or the versions are incompatible).
[Show output](command:striart.showOutput)
welcome.offline:
Offline: the connection to Striart was lost.
[Reconnect](command:striart.reconnect)
[Show output](command:striart.showOutput)
config.binaryPath: How to start Striart: a command name looked up in `PATH` (default `striart`) or an **absolute** path to the executable or to its entry script (`…/@jumsay/striart/src/cli.js`). Read from **user settings only** — a repository must never choose what runs on your machine.
config.nodePath: Node.js used when `striart.binaryPath` points to a script (or a Windows npm shim). A command name looked up in `PATH`, or an absolute path. User settings only.
config.root: Repository root, absolute or relative to the first workspace folder. Empty = the first workspace folder. `striart api` starts in this folder.
config.requestTimeout: Seconds to wait for a read-only answer (state, ticket, log).
config.actionTimeout: Seconds to wait for an action that can run a long time (merge with Test Gate, apply a resolution, start a task). Expiry does not cancel the operation: it may still be running.
config.reconnectInitial: First delay (seconds) before reconnecting after a lost connection; it doubles each attempt with jitter.
config.reconnectAttempts: Automatic reconnection attempts before staying offline (then use **Striart: Reconnect**). 0 disables automatic reconnection.
config.notifyRequests: Show a notification when an agent asks for a permission or asks a question.
